caption: A hammer resting on the top of a ladder is knocked off and falls to the ground.

sa.check: A hammer rests on the top of a ladder.
It is knocked off the ladder.
The knock comes first and the fall follows.

pc.expect: The hammer goes downward from the top of the ladder, falling quicker the further it drops, and reaches the ground.
pc.fail: The hammer drifts sideways away from the ladder as it falls; or it hangs in the air after leaving the top; or it rises after being knocked off.

pc.expect: The hammer lies still on the ladder until it is knocked, and once on the ground it stays there.
pc.fail: The hammer sets off before anything reaches it; or it slides off the top with nothing touching it; or it moves again after settling on the ground.

pc.expect: The hammer meets the ground and comes to rest there, clattering or bouncing low before it settles.
pc.fail: The hammer comes to rest in mid-air short of the ground; or it carries on down past the ground line; or the ground it lands on shows no disturbance at all where a heavy tool struck it.

pc.expect: The hammer stays a rigid head on a rigid handle, and the ground takes the impact.
pc.fail: The hammer bends or squashes where it lands; or it bounces high off a hard floor like a rubber ball; or it sinks into a hard floor as if into mud.

pc.expect: One hammer and one ladder keep their number and shape, and neither passes through the other.
pc.fail: The hammer vanishes on the way down or a second one appears; or it passes through a rung of the ladder; or it turns into another tool as it falls.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The hammer's colour, the ladder and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The hammer changes colour or size; or the ladder changes its number of rungs between frames; or the background rearranges.
